title: Watercolor "Cove Hollow House" 142 Cove Hollow Street
h1: Watercolor "Cove Hollow House" 142 Cove Hollow Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per Watercolor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 12 bands to access Watercolor amenities and community pools- 6-Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Located in the beautiful Lake community of WaterColor- Minutes from Frog Pool- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- 4 adult bikes provided- Fireplace- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Cove Hollow House is an exquisite 2-story, 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home—plus Carriage House—that sleeps 12 in the beautiful Lake community of WaterColor. Guests can access the newly expanded WaterColor beach club with chair service and 3 pools surrounded by scenic Gulf views. Enjoy spending time with friends and family in 2,921 square feet of living space, including the spacious fenced-in back porch and private patio!Experience ultimate relaxation on the beautiful front porch with cushioned furniture and views of the park. Step into the gorgeous first-floor great room, featuring high ceilings and abundant natural lighting. Relax in the living area, surrounded by high-end furnishings, a cozy fireplace, and a 65” TV—perfect for movie nights with the family. Prepare delicious meals in a pristine white kitchen, equipped with beautiful hardwood floors, Thermador appliances, and a sleek kitchen island with built-in appliances that can seat 3. The adjacent dining area can accommodate up to 8 guests on beachy rattan chairs. Retreat to the guest bedroom, furnished with a luxurious king bed and access to the front porch through French doors. Outside, a lovely fenced-in back porch provides plush seating and a TV, leading to a private patio with an alfresco dining table and a convenient propane grill.Ascend the stairs to the second floor of this home, where 2 spacious guest bedrooms await—1 bedroom with a king bed, private bath, and stacked washer and dryer, and the other featuring 2 sizeable queen beds. A quaint bunk area awaits the kids, complete with 2 twin-over-twin beds.Access the charming Carriage House through the patio in the backyard. Discover a fully equipped kitchen with baby blue appliances, a comfortable living area, and 1 cozy guest bedroom with a Queen bed. For a delightful dining experience, take advantage of the deck and enjoy any meal alfresco.Cove Hollow House enjoys access to multiple public beaches, including Van Ness Butler and Santa Clara Beach. With on-site parking for 2 vehicles—plus 4 adult bikes and a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle—it’s easy to explore the local area. Don’t wait, book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: 2 Twin/Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom With Shower Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Parties, weddings or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing. Fees apply.

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watercolor "Cove Hollow House" 142 Cove Hollow Street Santa Rosa Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-016382 Bedrooms 4 Beds 9 Sleeps 12 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per Watercolor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 12 bands to access Watercolor amenities and community pools - 6-Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Located in the beautiful Lake community of WaterColor - Minutes from Frog Pool - Surrounded by natural green space and parks - 4 adult bikes provided - Fireplace - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Cove Hollow House is an exquisite 2-story, 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home—plus Carriage House—that sleeps 12 in the beautiful Lake community of WaterColor. Guests can access the newly expanded WaterColor beach club with chair service and 3 pools surrounded by scenic Gulf views. Enjoy spending time with friends and family in 2,921 square feet of living space, including the spacious fenced-in back porch and private patio! Experience ultimate relaxation on the beautiful front porch with cushioned furniture and views of the park. Step into the gorgeous first-floor great room, featuring high ceilings and abundant natural lighting. Relax in the living area, surrounded by high-end furnishings, a cozy fireplace, and a 65” TV—perfect for movie nights with the family. Prepare delicious meals in a pristine white kitchen, equipped with beautiful hardwood floors, Thermador appliances, and a sleek kitchen island with built-in appliances that can seat 3. The adjacent dining area can accommodate up to 8 guests on beachy rattan chairs. Retreat to the guest bedroom, furnished with a luxurious king bed and access to the front porch through French doors. Outside, a lovely fenced-in back porch provides plush seating and a TV, leading to a private patio with an alfresco dining table and a convenient propane grill. Ascend the stairs to the second floor of this home, where 2 spacious guest bedrooms await—1 bedroom with a king bed, private bath, and stacked washer and dryer, and the other featuring 2 sizeable queen beds. A quaint bunk area awaits the kids, complete with 2 twin-over-twin beds. Access the charming Carriage House through the patio in the backyard. Discover a fully equipped kitchen with baby blue appliances, a comfortable living area, and 1 cozy guest bedroom with a Queen bed. For a delightful dining experience, take advantage of the deck and enjoy any meal alfresco. Cove Hollow House enjoys access to multiple public beaches, including Van Ness Butler and Santa Clara Beach. With on-site parking for 2 vehicles—plus 4 adult bikes and a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle—it’s easy to explore the local area. Don’t wait, book today!
